verses.text: Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Manh ak' pensar, a ach tzach och t'a yichanh jun winh rey chi' in k'exulok, haxo winh uk'tak aj Aarón ol lolon a k'exulok.
Masanil tas tzin chek ala', al t'a winh uk'tak chi', haxo winh ol lolon t'a yichanh winh rey chi' yik tzex yaktanel winh t'a smakb'en tik.
Ha inxo ol wak' pitb'okel spensar winh rey chi' yik ol stek'b'ej sb'a winh. Yuj chi' tzijtum tas satub'tak ol in ch'ox t'a Egipto tik.
Yujto manh ol schalaj yab' winh rey chi' tas ol eyala', yuj chi', a in ol in ch'ox wal wipalil wak'an yahelal t'a Egipto tik. Icha chi' ol aj ex wik'anelta t'a stzolal a ex in chonhab' Israel ex tik.
Ayik toxo ix in ch'ox wipalil chi', ayik toxo pax ex wik'elta, ichato chi' ol nachajel yuj heb' aj Egipto tik to a in ton Jehová in, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón tas ix yal Jehová.
Ha winhaj Moisés chi', 80 ab'il sk'inal winh, haxo winhaj Aarón chi', 83 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix lolon heb' winh t'a yichanh winh sreyal Egipto chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik:
--Tato sk'an winh rey chi' yil junok ch'oxnab'il, tzalan t'a winhaj Aarón tik to syaktejem te' sk'okoch winh t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ol och te' chanil, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atxi heb' winh schawanhil t'a winh rey chi', ix sk'anab'ajan heb' winh sk'ulan icha ix yal Jehová. Ix yaktanem te' sk'okoch winhaj Aarón t'a yichanh winh rey yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' ay yopisio yet' winh, elanhchamel ix och te' chanil.
Ayik ix yilan winh rey icha chi', ix schek winh awtaj heb' winh aj Egipto, heb' winh jelan yet' juntzanh yik yajb'alil, ix sk'ulan heb' winh icha ix sk'ulej winhaj Aarón chi'.
Ix yaktejpaxem sk'okoch heb' winh t'a sat lu'um, ix ochpax chanil, palta ix turjib'at sk'okoch heb' winh chi' yuj yik winhaj Aarón chi'.
Wach'chom icha chi' ix aji, palta manh jab'ok ix scha yab' winh rey chi'. Ix yak'nhej pitb'okel spensar winh icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ix pitb'i'el spensar winh rey chi', maj aktajel heb' in chonhab' Israel yuj winh.
Ayik sakb'inaj k'ik'an, tzex b'at t'a sti' ha' niwan Nilo, tze tanhwan sk'och winh achanwel ta'. Tzeyik'anb'at te' k'okoch ix och chanil.

Hata' tzeyal t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh hebreo onh tik, a chekannak onh kot ul kal t'ayach to tzonh aktejel a onh schonhab' onh tik, yik b'at onh och ejmelal t'ay t'a tzinan lu'um. Palta masanto tikne'ik manh jab'ok tza cha ab'i.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi to ay tas ol sch'ox ila' yik tzojtakejeli to a Jehová chi' anhejton Dios Aytaxonek'i. Ayik ol in mak'an sat ha ha' tik yet' te' in k'okoch yamb'ilk'e wuj tik, ol och ha' chik'al.
Masanil nok' chay ol chamok, ol k'e sjab' ha', manhxo ol yal-laj eyuk'an jab'ok ha' tik, xa chi t'a winh rey chi'.

--Tzalpax t'a winhaj Aarón to syak'b'at te' sk'okoch winh t'a yib'anhtak sjaj ha ha' t'a Egipto tik: T'a yib'anh ha' kotak yet' ha' niwak melem yet' t'a yib'anh ha' nhajab' tonhej molan. Masanil ha ha' ay t'a yol yik Egipto tik ol laj och ha' chik'al yet' masanil ha' ayem t'a yol yet'tal yet' t'a yoltak jukub', xchi Jehová.

Icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová chi', icha chi' ix yutej winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi'. Ix yik'ank'e te' sk'okoch winhaj Aarón chi', ix smak'an sat ha ha' winh t'a yichanh winh rey yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh. T'a wal jun rato chi' ix och ha' chik'al.
Masanil nok' chay ay t'a yol ha' Nilo chi', ix laj cham nok'. Ix k'e sjab' ha', majxo yal-laj yuk'an ha' heb' aj Egipto chi'. Masanil ha ha' ay ta', chik'xonhej ix aj ha'.

Icha pax chi' ix yutej heb' winh ay t'a yol yik Egipto chi', yujto ay tas tzuji yuj heb' winh yuj tas k'ayb'ab'il yuj. Icha chi' ix aj spitanxi sb'a winh rey icha ix aj yalan Jehová. Maj schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi'.
Malaj wal jab'ok yelk'och tas ix yal heb' winh chi' t'a yol sat winh rey chi', ix meltzaj winh t'a sdespacho.
Masanil heb' anima t'a Egipto chi', ix sjoy ha ha' heb' yik syuk'ej t'a stitak ha ha' chi', yujto masanil ha ha' chi' maxtzak yal-laj yuk'ji.
